title: 2023 Pokemon Nidoran 032/165 Reverse 151 SV2a Japanese Poke Ball
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This 2023 Near Mint Pokemon Nidoran 032/165 Reverse 151 SV2a Japanese Poke Ball is a must-have for any Pokémon TCG collector. The card features a Standard size with a Card Stock material and a Reverse Holo finish. It is a Stage 1 Pokémon card with the character Nidoran (♂) and is manufactured by Nintendo.

The card is perfect for players aged 6+ and is part of the 151 set with a Japanese language. It is not autographed and is not considered vintage. The card is a Pokeball with speciality features and is ideal for those who enjoy Collectible Card Games. Add this rare and unique card to your collection today!
